I found no bugs in the uncommitted change, `orders/status.py`, which is the only changed file.

- **`latest_status`:** `order.events[-1]` can't raise `IndexError`. `Order.__post_init__` in `model.py` always appends a `created` event, and events are append-only.
- **`notify_status`:** it logs a mailer failure with `log.exception` and then re-raises, so the failure isn't swallowed or logged twice. `Mailer.send` has the same signature as the call.

I didn't run any code or tests. The review was a read of the new file against `model.py` and `notify.py`.
